description: This file defines culture-specific information and utility methods for date parsing, formatting, and manipulation, specifically for the 'en-US' culture. It also extends the Date prototype with additional methods for date calculations and formatting.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero, effectively setting the time to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same timestamp.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this Date is equal to another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name, abbreviation, or shortest form.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month of a given year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a named timezone.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts the Date object to ISO 8601 string format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats the Date object into a string based on the specified pattern.
